description: A transplant coordinator must decide which of two listed patients should receive a deceased-donor kidney offer and finalize the operating-room and organ-preparation plan, with input from the transplant surgeon and the organ procurement coordinator.

shared_context.S1: The hospital has received one deceased-donor kidney offer for two active candidates, Elena Ruiz and Marcus Bell.
shared_context.S2: Maya makes the final recipient and operating-room plan decision.
shared_context.S3: Both candidates are medically listed for kidney transplantation and are available for evaluation today.
shared_context.S4: The transplant service uses a brief huddle before accepting an organ offer, during which the surgeon and organ procurement coordinator report their current findings and operational requirements to Maya.

PF1.text: Dr. Chen reviewed the donor-recipient virtual crossmatch: Marcus Bell is compatible with this kidney, while Elena Ruiz has a positive crossmatch and must not receive it.

PF2.text: The procurement record specifies that this kidney must remain on hypothermic machine perfusion until implantation, and the only prepared machine is in OR 4; Luis has confirmed that OR 4 can receive the organ for the transplant.

acceptance_conditions: The kidney offer must be accepted.
Marcus Bell must be selected as the recipient.
OR 4 must be assigned for the transplant.
Hypothermic machine perfusion must be specified as the organ-preparation method.
A commitment to keep the kidney on machine perfusion until implantation must be recorded.
The compatibility finding must be cited as justification for selecting Marcus Bell.

provenance_checks.P1: 'PF1' in credited_facts and 'PF1' in justification_fact_ids and 'PF1' in revealed

decisive_facts.why: The virtual crossmatch changes the recipient from an unresolved choice between Elena Ruiz and Marcus Bell to Marcus Bell, because Elena Ruiz has a positive crossmatch and Marcus Bell is compatible.
The procurement record changes the operating room to OR 4, the preparation method to hypothermic machine perfusion, and the plan to continue that perfusion until implantation.
